Fix: post<T>() now takes a `consume` callback and settles the whole request (headers + body) under one deadline that rejects with a timeout error even when the transport ignores the abort signal; readRefreshAnswer() returns 401/403 refusal synchronously (no body read, non-retryable sign-out semantics unchanged) and reads the body otherwise. revokeApiSession uses the same post. The timeout rejection is retryable, sessionKeeper's existing `finally { inflight = false }` clears the guard and its backoff retries. Regression: __tests__/sessionRefreshBodyStall.test.ts (4 failed on base, exit 1; passes on HEAD). (3) Adversary break 2 (P1, clock rollback): apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts stamped records with `nowIso: () => new Date().toISOString()` (base line 1599); packages/analysis-pipeline/src/strokeAutoResolution.ts isVerifiedCompletedCaptureRecord rejects a record when capturedAtIso / selectedAtIso > createdAtIso or a model run completedAtIso > createdAtIso (lines 1273-1284, 1298-1302), and originalAnalysisOperations.ts recordMatches() (isVerifiedCompletedCaptureRecord at line 1164, held('commit_not_admitted') at line 1221) turns that into commit_not_admitted → OriginalAnalysisHeldError → recovery_pending with the permit finalised 'failed'; the direct runner's replay path fails the same verification on read. Record timestamps can therefore never precede the evidence they describe; with a monotonic device clock the output is identical to before. No shared-package verifier was touched.
